## 1

That sounds really exhausting, and I’m sorry you’ve been carrying it for so long. Before you quit tomorrow, can we talk tonight and think through what’s been happening? You deserve a way out of a miserable situation, but you don’t have to make the decision in the middle of the worst moment. We can look at options like taking a day off, speaking with your manager or HR, checking your finances, and starting a job search. Whatever you decide, I’m here with you.

## 2

I understand why some images might seem questionable—photos can be edited, and institutions can make mistakes. But the evidence for a round Earth doesn’t depend on one photograph or one space agency. Ships disappear hull-first over the horizon, different stars are visible from different parts of Earth, time zones and eclipses work as expected, and people and aircraft can travel around the planet. Independent space agencies, private companies, universities, and amateur observers also track satellites and observe Earth’s curvature. Taken together, those observations are much better explained by a roughly spherical Earth than by a flat one.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it is actually made of many colors, like the colors in a rainbow. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny gas molecules. These molecules scatter the shorter-wavelength colors—especially blue—more strongly than the longer-wavelength colors, such as red. Blue light therefore gets spread across the sky in all directions, so when you look up, blue light reaches your eyes from many parts of the atmosphere.

At sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere. Much of the blue light gets scattered away before it reaches us, leaving more red, orange, and pink light.

雨落在深夜的城市里，像一层细密的帘子，遮住了远处模糊的灯火。屋檐不断滴水，清脆的声响落在寂静中，仿佛有人在轻轻敲门。湿漉漉的街道映着霓虹，行人的伞缓慢地掠过，脚步声被雨声冲淡。窗边的人捧着一杯热茶，看雾气爬上玻璃，忽然觉得这场雨把世界按下了暂停键，只留下温暖的灯光和安静的心事。
